title: A LOOKUPVALUE search column can be a column of a related one-side table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", LOOKUPVALUE ( Sales[Amount], Product[Product], "Lock", Sales[Quantity], 5 ) )

source.quote: When providing the column to search into, you can use any column of the expanded table
source.supports: any column of the expanded table can be searched

source.quote: The Search_ColumnName can be any column of the expanded table referenced by Result_ColumnName

derivation: Product[Product] is a column of the expanded Sales table. Lock is ProductKey 3: Sales rows 4 and 6. Of those, Quantity 5 is row 4: Amount 50.
